text: APPROVE. `AppendStar` reproduces the original `*` handling exactly (single `*` gives `[^/]*`, `**/` gives `(?:[^/]*/)*` and advances by 2, trailing `**` gives `.*` and advances by 1), and moving the nested branches out of `ToRegex` clearly drops its complexity below 15. The new private static helper uses the same fully qualified `StringBuilder` and adds no unused members, so the build should not pick up new warnings. I read the diff only and did not build or run tests.
